name: TechCrunch

sources.title: Contact Us — tips@techcrunch.com; 'We do not accept pitches or guest post submissions'
How to tip TechCrunch — Signal/WhatsApp +1 415-320-7755, username techcrunch.01; SecureDrop paused

requirements: Not a directory — coverage is earned editorial. There is no submission form or listing product
News tips go to tips@techcrunch.com; discreet/secure tips via Signal or WhatsApp (+1 415-320-7755, username techcrunch.01); SecureDrop currently paused
The contact page explicitly states TechCrunch does not accept pitches or guest post submissions — the old Extra Crunch guest column program is discontinued
Realistic path: be a credible source for staff reporters covering your beat (funding, launches, pivots, exec hires, partnerships)
preparation: A genuinely newsworthy hook: funding round, product launch, pivot, key hire, partnership
Three-to-four-sentence tip: the claim, supporting evidence, why it matters now
Know which reporter covers your category and target them, not a generic blast
workflow: Identify the reporter(s) covering your space
Send the tip to tips@techcrunch.com (or the reporter directly); for sensitive material use Signal/WhatsApp
For embargoes: first ask whether the writer accepts embargoes, then send details — an uninvited embargoed email is on the record
Coverage, if it happens, is a staff-written article — no listing page is created
watchFor: A reporter's inbox is on-the-record — anything sent can be published
Do not send guest posts or generic 'please write about us' pitches — explicitly not accepted
Mass-blasting all reporters hurts credibility; target narrowly
Anyone selling 'guaranteed TechCrunch coverage' is not selling a real submission route
countsAsLive: A TechCrunch article mentioning or profiling the product/company is published at techcrunch.com
unknowns: No listing exists to verify — publication is purely at editorial discretion
